name: field-security-isolation-audit
objective: Prove simple proportional server-side Field isolation/audit across every causal surface without multiplying operator roles unnecessarily.
truthOwner: Identity and each domain backend own authorization; UI never substitutes server enforcement.

tasks.objective: Eliminate bypasses and overexposure while keeping Control Panel permission design operationally simple.
tasks.currentProblem: Field objects span Workforce, Partners, Marketing, DSH and WLT. A small team does not justify many artificial roles, but direct APIs still require strict object/action authorization and sensitive audit.
tasks.requiredChange: Use a minimal practical operator permission set/super-admin model already supported by canonical Identity; require server-side object scope for Field actors and operator actions; require reason+audit for suspend/terminate/reassign/reject/publication override/financial adjustment; delete stale aliases/UI-only guards and cancelled incident/COD permissions.
tasks.targetState: Field A cannot list/read/mutate Field B or unrelated stores; operator actions are authorized by simple canonical permissions and audited when sensitive; no redundant security layer or stale permission path remains.
tasks.action: Enumerate endpoints/list/search/deep-links/cache/replay/uploads/publication/finance actions from U002-U011, run negative matrix, fix root query/auth boundaries, remove obsolete permissions/routes, and add regression tests.
mustNotChange: لا تعقيد role matrix بلا حاجة تجارية.
لا broad bypass أو cross-field existence leak.
acceptanceCriteria: Cross-field/cross-store reads and writes fail server-side.
Sensitive actions require authorized actor and reason/audit where approved.
Marketing override and WLT finance authority are isolated.
Permission model remains small, canonical and free of duplicate engines.
tasks.rollback: Security uses forward-fix only; never restore a bypass for compatibility.
tasks.commitBoundary: Security hardening grouped by shared root cause.
